defects.what: Three stacked close-up faces of three different young men in separate horizontal strips: a three-panel collage, and none of them is Indio.
A hard vertical seam down the middle joins two different table pictures (left and right halves do not match: table edge, light, wall).
The man in blue behind Indio has a face fused into the back of Indio's head, and extra clapping hands next to Indio's arm with the red kerchief read as Indio's own.
The whole frame is a receipt under a magnifier full of large red pseudo-numbers and Korean-like glyph rows.
Gold seal at bottom right ringed with CJK-like characters and Latin letters ('NOE', 'BPE'); the blue signature scrawl itself is acceptable.
The whole page is glowing and typed pseudo-English ('the mgyreds ehe do, ad thel wbr'), large and readable as gibberish.
Large bronze historical marker behind Indio covered in pseudo-English lines ('CORABECTED O PHILIPPINS ...'), and Indio's booklet also has text.
Indio holds a document at the centre of the frame covered in pseudo-text with a red circle around gibberish lines.
Tally sheets across the table in the foreground with pseudo-handwriting and numbers, and 'BAL' on a box at bottom right.
Stack of papers by Usman's paw reads 'KAWIT CAVITE' followed by pseudo-handwritten lines.
Flood gauge on the wall with garbled numbers (66, 04, 63, 06, 106 out of order) and a blue sign with pseudo-text at its top.
A large red logo-like mark on the white hard hat at the top of the frame; the form under her pen also carries small pseudo-text.
A huge red arrow-and-ring logo fills the background and a big red 'D' is printed on the green shirt.
The certificate under the folder carries a pseudo-signature line ('Sanna Jnapmh...') and a red stamp with glyphs at bottom of frame.
Full-frame manuscript of pseudo-cursive; reads as a period page but the words are gibberish if a viewer looks closely.
Red sign 'KAWIT CAVITE PHILIPPINES' at top left (readable, place is right) and a pseudo-text logo on the driver's cap.
Partial 'CA' wall sign behind Indio and pseudo-text on the paper in his hand.
Wall of posted sheets with small pseudo-text lines and tables.
Small pseudo-text on Bea's ID card and notebook; and small shop sign glyphs in the background.
Logo mark on JM's cap and a small badge on the motorcycle tank.
Small printed logos on the chests of two bystanders' shirts.
Hologram panel by Indio's wrist shows a UI bar with a question mark and a '%' sign.
Usman has both ears pricked up and pointed (no folded ear), and Indio here has no medallion.
